say:3:1223407002:1.text: The goods were stolen, and Thoreau is missing.
say:3:1223407002:1.source_cn: 货被抢了，梭罗也不见了。

say:4:1223407003:1.source_cn: 说实话，你对这个结果也不意外了吧？

say:5:1223407004:1.text: Indeed. I'm used to dealing with all sorts of mishaps every day.
say:5:1223407004:1.source_cn: 是啊，我都习惯每天处理数十个意外了……

say:6:1223407005:1.text: But this time, the galefish was pre-ordered by a customer. To the catch the fish, Thoreau hasn't slept for two days.
say:6:1223407005:1.source_cn: 但这次的狂风鱼，是顾客特意定的货，梭罗为了定期交货两天没睡。
